non_negotiable: The external manuscript is never touched by the rig. The rig persists only ideas, story blocks, an optional shared WIP, and derived data.

materials.what: a contained, voiced draft piece the writer carries out to the manuscript
an optional, writer-shared draft of the actual piece, held in-rig to be worked with
materials.notes: Never presumed in sync with the external manuscript. Not a pipeline stage. The writer pushes it in; the rig never pulls. The rig proposes edits via a -machinima sidecar and never edits the WIP in place; carrying any change to the external manuscript is the writer's manual act.

pipeline.axis: how PROCESSED an idea is, never what it is about

zones.semantics: raw dumps, exactly as written — frozen, append-only, never edited
a flat living graph of atomic, linked idea-notes — where growth happens
the distilled truth of this story

orthogonal_zones.semantics: the optional shared draft of the actual piece; edits are proposed via <wip>-machinima.md and superseded versions are kept in wip/archive/

tokens.boundary: a design-layer registry, not a line-by-line index of the manuscript

lens.story: what the viewer's lens witnesses — what falls inside the frame
lens.act-zero: everything outside the frame — the seed before there is a plot

boost: the one scoped machine-write: on request, turn ideas into one voiced story block, then hand the pen back
